title: Homogeneous sections of the canonical symmetric algebra sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal F)$ for its canonical symmetric algebra sheaf and $\theta_V:\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_X(V)}(\mathcal F(V))\to\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal F)(V)$ for the sheafification section map [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]; on affine opens this is the canonical identification [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra]. Use the canonical affine-basis grading $A_X(\mathcal F)(V)_n$ of [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. For $n\in\mathbb N$, an open $U\subseteq X$, and $s\in\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal F)(U)$, define $s$ to be a homogeneous section of symmetric degree $n$ if, for every affine open $V\subseteq U$, there is $a\in A_X(\mathcal F)(V)_n$ such that $\theta_V(a)=s|_V$. This is the affine-basis description of the sections of the degree-$n$ subsheaf.
